title: Any games on your wishlist to try and make a remake for?
author: completelypositive
selftext:
I have two. Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: My Life as a King and even further back, an old KOEI game Celtic Tales Balor of the Evil Eye.

I have wanted to replay these for so long but never had the capacity to learn. I am busy teaching myself on a typing game project using opus 4.5 and vscode. Hoping to learn AI graphics next and try to do a new version of one of those.

comments.author: Still_Ad9431
comments.body: I am developing Tenchu remake and splinter cell remake because Fromsoft doesn't want to do it and Ubisoft made Sam Fisher gay

replies.author: completelypositive
replies.body:
Awesome! Good luck. 

Were you around when they did that internet puzzle for one of the earlier Splinter cell games? Pretty sure it was SC. They had puzzles and clues and everyone on their internet forum (before reddit way way back when) was trying to solve it. One of their puzzles was a puzzle from a book called cryptonomicon and it was my favorite book, so I got it right and got a special custom forum title. Felt like a badass for a minute.
